# mergegateway_guardrails (Data Source)

Lists the guardrails in force for every project: its controls, prompt-injection (PI) settings and DLP rules, after applying the project's overrides to the organization's settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mergegateway_guardrails" "all" {}

# Projects where prompt-injection protection doesn't block.
output "projects_without_pi_blocking" {
  value = [
    for g in data.mergegateway_guardrails.all.guardrails : g.project_name
    if g.pi_settings.pi_mode != "block"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `guardrails` (Attributes List) One entry per project, in the API's order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--guardrails))

<a id="nestedatt--guardrails"></a>
### Nested Schema for `guardrails`

Read-Only:

- `controls` (Attributes) The vendor, region and zero data retention controls in force. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--guardrails--controls))
- `dlp_entities` (Attributes List) How the project treats each DLP entity type, seeded and custom. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--guardrails--dlp_entities))
- `pi_settings` (Attributes) The prompt-injection settings in force. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--guardrails--pi_settings))
- `project_id` (String) The project's ID.
- `project_name` (String) The project's name.

<a id="nestedatt--guardrails--controls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `guardrails.controls`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_regions` (List of String) The only regions requests may be served from; empty for any.
- `allowed_vendors` (List of String) The only vendors requests may be served by; empty for any.
- `ignored_regions` (List of String) The regions requests are never served from.
- `ignored_vendors` (List of String) The vendors requests are never served by.
- `vendor_routing_preference` (List of String) The vendors to prefer, most preferred first.
- `zero_data_retention` (Boolean) Whether requests go only to vendors that retain no data.


<a id="nestedatt--guardrails--dlp_entities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `guardrails.dlp_entities`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) `custom` for the organization's own rules; `global` and `usa` are seeded.
- `effective_action` (String) What happens when it matches: `log`, `redact` or `block`. Null when the rule is off.
- `entity_type` (String) The entity type, such as `EMAIL_ADDRESS`.
- `overridden` (Boolean) Whether the project overrides the organization's rule.


<a id="nestedatt--guardrails--pi_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `guardrails.pi_settings`

Read-Only:

- `pi_allowlist_patterns` (List of String) The effective `pi_allowlist_patterns`.
- `pi_block_threshold` (Number) The effective `pi_block_threshold`.
- `pi_fail_closed` (Boolean) The effective `pi_fail_closed`.
- `pi_indirect_mode` (String) The effective `pi_indirect_mode`.
- `pi_mode` (String) The effective `pi_mode`.
- `pi_output_action` (String) The effective `pi_output_action`.
- `pi_tier2a_block_threshold` (Number) The effective `pi_tier2a_block_threshold`.
- `pi_tier2b_block_threshold` (Number) The effective `pi_tier2b_block_threshold`.
